title: MoM turnover (last 6 months) from daily indicators
question: What is month-over-month turnover for the last 6 months?
sql_text:
-- MoM turnover from SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS (last 6 months)
WITH m AS (
  SELECT TRUNC(STATS_DATE, 'MM') AS month,
         SUM(TURNOVER_VALUE) AS turnover
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS
  WHERE STATS_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -6)
  GROUP BY TRUNC(STATS_DATE, 'MM')
)
SELECT month,
       turnover,
       (turnover - LAG(turnover) OVER (ORDER BY month))
         / NULLIF(LAG(turnover) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0) AS mom
FROM m
ORDER BY month
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
notes: Monthly bucket via TRUNC(STATS_DATE,'MM'); computes MoM using LAG; SELECT-only with FETCH FIRST.

title: Top 10 symbols by median daily close in the most recent full month (with labels)
question: Which 10 symbols had the highest median daily close in the most recent full month?
sql_text:
-- Top 10 symbols by median CLOSE_PRICE in the most recent full calendar month
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM'), -1) AS d0,
         TRUNC(SYSDATE,'MM') AS d1
  FROM dual
),
d AS (
  SELECT SYMBOL_ID,
         TRUNC(STATS_DATE, 'DD') AS day,
         CLOSE_PRICE
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS, bounds
  WHERE STATS_DATE >= bounds.d0
    AND STATS_DATE <  bounds.d1
)
SELECT s.SYMBOL,
       d.SYMBOL_ID,
       MEDIAN(d.CLOSE_PRICE) AS median_close
FROM d
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = d.SYMBOL_ID
GROUP BY s.SYMBOL, d.SYMBOL_ID
ORDER BY median_close DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
notes: Filters to last full month; aggregates median over daily CLOSE_PRICE per symbol.

title: P95 spread (offer - bid) per exchange over the last 30 days
question: What is the 95th percentile spread by exchange for the last 30 days?
sql_text:
-- P95 spread (OFFER_PRICE - BID_PRICE) per exchange (30 days)
SELECT e.EXCHANGE_NAME,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (b.OFFER_PRICE - b.BID_PRICE)) AS p95_spread
FROM ATS.BEST_MKT b
JOIN ATS.EXCHANGES e ON e.EXCHANGE_ID = b.EXCHANGE_ID
WHERE b.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
GROUP BY e.EXCHANGE_NAME
ORDER BY p95_spread DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
notes: Uses PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) over (OFFER_PRICE - BID_PRICE); grouped by exchange label.

title: 7-day rolling average of daily turnover per symbol (last 60 days, preview)
question: Show a preview of 7-day rolling average of daily turnover per symbol for the last 60 days.
sql_text:
-- 7-day rolling average of daily turnover per symbol (preview)
WITH d AS (
  SELECT SYMBOL_ID,
         TRUNC(STATS_DATE, 'DD') AS day,
         SUM(TURNOVER_VALUE) AS turnover
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS
  WHERE STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 60
  GROUP BY SYMBOL_ID, TRUNC(STATS_DATE, 'DD')
)
SELECT s.SYMBOL,
       d.SYMBOL_ID,
       d.day,
       AVG(d.turnover) OVER (
         PARTITION BY d.SYMBOL_ID
         ORDER BY d.day
         ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS turnover_7d_avg
FROM d
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = d.SYMBOL_ID
ORDER BY d.SYMBOL_ID, d.day
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
notes: Daily bucket with TRUNC('DD'); 7-row rolling window for 7 days.

title: Latest OHLC + total trades count per symbol (e.g. May 2024)
question: Give me trades count and current OHLC per symbol for May 2024
sql_text:
-- Correct pattern: total trades over period + LATEST day's OHLC (not averages!)
WITH period_data AS (
  SELECT
    sdi.SYMBOL_ID,
    sym.SYMBOL,
    SUM(sdi.TRADES_COUNT) AS total_trades,
    MAX(sdi.STATS_DATE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY sdi.STATS_DATE) AS latest_date
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS sym ON sym.SYMBOL_ID = sdi.SYMBOL_ID
  WHERE sdi.STATS_DATE >= DATE '2024-05-01'
    AND sdi.STATS_DATE <  DATE '2024-06-01'
  GROUP BY sdi.SYMBOL_ID, sym.SYMBOL
)
SELECT
  pd.SYMBOL,
  pd.total_trades,
  sdi.OPEN_PRICE   AS open,
  sdi.HIGH_PRICE   AS high,
  sdi.LOW_PRICE    AS low,
  sdi.CLOSE_PRICE  AS close,
  sdi.STATS_DATE   AS price_date
FROM period_data pd
JOIN ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  ON sdi.SYMBOL_ID = pd.SYMBOL_ID
 AND sdi.STATS_DATE = pd.latest_date
ORDER BY pd.total_trades DESC
FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;
notes: CRITICAL CHANGE from old fs-008: shows LATEST day's OHLC (not averages or max/min). This is what traders actually look at. Old pattern of AVG(open)/AVG(close) is almost never correct and has been removed.

title: State breakdown by SYMBOL for the current year
question: For each symbol, show the number of orders by state in the current year.
sql_text:
-- State breakdown by SYMBOL for the current year
WITH year_bounds AS (
  SELECT TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE)+1), 'YYYY') AS y0,
         ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12) AS y1
  FROM dual
)
SELECT s.SYMBOL,
       st.STATE_CODE,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM ATS.ORDERS o
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = o.SYMBOL_ID
JOIN ATS.ORDER_STATES st ON st.STATE_ID = o.STATE
WHERE o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= (SELECT y0 FROM year_bounds)
  AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME <  (SELECT y1 FROM year_bounds)
GROUP BY s.SYMBOL, st.STATE_CODE
ORDER BY s.SYMBOL, st.STATE_CODE
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Joins order states for STATE_CODE label; year bounds via y0/y1.

title: Negotiated → executed mapping: notional by symbol (last 30 days)
question: For negotiated orders in the last 30 days, what executed notional did they lead to by symbol?
sql_text:
-- Negotiated → executed mapping: executed notional by symbol (last 30 days)
-- Map NEGOTIATED_TRADES order numbers to TRADES buyer/seller order numbers on the same exchange.
WITH nt_orders AS (
  SELECT EXCHANGE_ID, ORDER_NO AS ORD_NO
  FROM ATS.NEGOTIATED_TRADES
  WHERE ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
  UNION ALL
  SELECT EXCHANGE_ID, COUNTER_ORDER_NO
  FROM ATS.NEGOTIATED_TRADES
  WHERE ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
),
t_match AS (
  SELECT t.SYMBOL_ID,
         t.EXCHANGE_ID,
         (t.PRICE * t.VOLUME) AS notional
  FROM ATS.TRADES t
  JOIN nt_orders n
    ON n.EXCHANGE_ID = t.EXCHANGE_ID
   AND (t.BUYER_ORDER_NO = n.ORD_NO OR t.SELLER_ORDER_NO = n.ORD_NO)
  WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
)
SELECT s.SYMBOL,
       SUM(m.notional) AS negotiated_executed_notional
FROM t_match m
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = m.SYMBOL_ID
GROUP BY s.SYMBOL
ORDER BY negotiated_executed_notional DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Maps negotiated orders to executed trades via order numbers; totals notional by symbol label.

title: Bonds: average yield and total settlement by settlement type (YTD)
question: For bond trades year-to-date, show average yield and total settlement amount by settlement type.
sql_text:
-- Bonds: avg YIELD and sum SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT by settlement type (YTD)
WITH ytd AS (
  SELECT TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -EXTRACT(MONTH FROM SYSDATE)+1), 'YYYY') AS y0
  FROM dual
)
SELECT NVL(sty.SETTLEMENT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(t.SETTLEMENT_TYPE_ID)) AS settlement_type,
       COUNT(*) AS trades_cnt,
       AVG(t.YIELD) AS avg_yield,
       SUM(t.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT) AS settlement_amount
FROM ATS.TRADES t
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s       ON s.SYMBOL_ID = t.SYMBOL_ID
JOIN ATS.SYMBOL_TYPES st ON st.SYMBOL_TYPE_ID = s.SYMBOL_TYPE_ID
LEFT JOIN ATS.SETTLEMENT_TYPES sty ON sty.SETTLEMENT_TYPE_ID = t.SETTLEMENT_TYPE_ID
CROSS JOIN ytd
WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= ytd.y0
  AND UPPER(st.SYMBOL_TYPE) LIKE 'BOND%'
GROUP BY NVL(sty.SETTLEMENT_TYPE, TO_CHAR(t.SETTLEMENT_TYPE_ID))
ORDER BY settlement_amount DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Filters to bonds via SYMBOL_TYPES; groups by settlement type with label when available.

title: Repo — daily cash flow by exchange & leg (last 30 days)
question: Show daily repo cash flow (sum of settlement amounts) by exchange and leg for the last 30 days. Also show repo type.

-- Daily repo cash flow by exchange & leg (last 30 days)
WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(rc.ENTRY_DATETIME) AS day,
    e.EXCHANGE_CODE          AS exchange,
    rc.LEG,
    rc.REPO_TYPE,
    rc.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT
  FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS rc
  JOIN ATS.EXCHANGES e
    ON e.EXCHANGE_ID = rc.EXCHANGE_ID
  WHERE rc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
)
SELECT
  w.day,
  w.exchange,
  w.LEG,
  w.REPO_TYPE,
  ROUND(SUM(w.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT), 2) AS cash_flow,
  COUNT(*)                            AS contracts

ORDER BY w.day DESC, cash_flow DESC

notes: Daily cash flow by exchange/leg; sums SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT; includes repo type.

title: Repo — active repos average rate & haircut by maturity bucket and symbol
question: For active repo contracts today, show average repo rate and average haircut by maturity bucket and symbol.
sql_text:
-- Active repos: average repo rate & haircut by maturity bucket and symbol
WITH active AS (
  SELECT
    rc.SYMBOL_ID,
    rc.REPO_RATE,
    rc.REPO_HAIRCUT,
    rc.INITIAL_DATE,
    rc.TERMINATION_DATE
  FROM REPO_CONTRACTS rc
  WHERE rc.TERMINATION_DATE > SYSDATE
    AND rc.INITIAL_DATE IS NOT NULL
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    s.SYMBOL,
    CASE
      WHEN (a.TERMINATION_DATE - a.INITIAL_DATE) <= 7  THEN '0–7d'
      WHEN (a.TERMINATION_DATE - a.INITIAL_DATE) <= 30 THEN '8–30d'
      WHEN (a.TERMINATION_DATE - a.INITIAL_DATE) <= 90 THEN '31–90d'
      ELSE '>90d'
    END AS MATURITY_BUCKET,
    a.REPO_RATE,
    a.REPO_HAIRCUT
  FROM active a
  JOIN SYMBOLS s
    ON s.SYMBOL_ID = a.SYMBOL_ID
)
SELECT
  b.MATURITY_BUCKET,
  b.SYMBOL,
  ROUND(AVG(b.REPO_RATE),   4) AS AVG_REPO_RATE,
  ROUND(AVG(b.REPO_HAIRCUT),4) AS AVG_HAIRCUT,
  COUNT(*)                    AS CONTRACT_LEGS
FROM bucketed b
GROUP BY b.MATURITY_BUCKET, b.SYMBOL
ORDER BY
  CASE b.MATURITY_BUCKET
    WHEN '0–7d' THEN 1
    WHEN '8–30d' THEN 2
    WHEN '31–90d' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END,
  b.SYMBOL
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
notes: Active contracts where TERMINATION_DATE>SYSDATE; maturity buckets by day difference; joins symbol label. (Note: SQL lacks ATS. prefix on REPO_CONTRACTS/SYMBOLS in source file.)

title: Repo — cancellations vs executed ratio by symbol (current quarter)
question: For the current quarter, show symbols with most cancelled repo legs and their cancellation ratio versus executed legs.
sql_text:
-- Repo cancellations vs executed ratio by symbol (current quarter)
WITH q AS (SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q') AS qstart FROM dual),
execs AS (
  SELECT
    rc.SYMBOL_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS exec_legs
  FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS rc
  JOIN q ON 1=1
  WHERE rc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= q.qstart
  GROUP BY rc.SYMBOL_ID
),
canc AS (
  SELECT
    cc.SYMBOL_ID,
    COUNT(*) AS cancelled_legs
  FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS_CANCELLED cc
  JOIN q ON 1=1
  WHERE cc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= q.qstart
  GROUP BY cc.SYMBOL_ID
)
SELECT
  s.SYMBOL,
  NVL(canc.cancelled_legs, 0) AS cancelled_legs,
  NVL(execs.exec_legs, 0)     AS exec_legs,
  CASE
    WHEN NVL(canc.cancelled_legs, 0) + NVL(execs.exec_legs, 0) = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE ROUND(NVL(canc.cancelled_legs, 0) / (NVL(canc.cancelled_legs, 0) + NVL(execs.exec_legs, 0)), 4)
  END AS cancel_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT SYMBOL_ID FROM (
    SELECT SYMBOL_ID FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS           WHERE ENTRY_DATETIME >= (SELECT qstart FROM q)
    UNION
    SELECT SYMBOL_ID FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS_CANCELLED WHERE ENTRY_DATETIME >= (SELECT qstart FROM q)
  )
) ids
LEFT JOIN execs ON execs.SYMBOL_ID = ids.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN canc  ON canc.SYMBOL_ID  = ids.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = ids.SYMBOL_ID
ORDER BY cancelled_legs DESC, cancel_ratio DESC, s.SYMBOL
FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Quarter-to-date via TRUNC(SYSDATE,'Q'); compares cancelled vs executed repo legs; joins symbol label.

title: Clients with >5 orders last month but fewer executions
question: List clients who placed more than 5 orders in last month but had lesser executions with their count

WITH date_range AS (
  SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AS start_date,
         TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AS end_date
  FROM dual
),
client_orders AS (
  SELECT o.CLIENT_ID, COUNT(*) AS total_orders
  FROM ATS.ORDERS o
  CROSS JOIN date_range dr
  WHERE o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= dr.start_date
    AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME < dr.end_date
  GROUP BY o.CLIENT_ID
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 5
),
client_executions AS (
  -- count executions for both roles in TRADES
  SELECT client_id, COUNT(*) AS total_executions
  FROM (
    SELECT t.BUYER_CLIENT_ID AS client_id
    FROM ATS.TRADES t
    CROSS JOIN date_range dr
    WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= dr.start_date
      AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME < dr.end_date
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.SELLER_CLIENT_ID AS client_id
    FROM ATS.TRADES t
    CROSS JOIN date_range dr
    WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= dr.start_date
      AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME < dr.end_date
  ) x
  GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT
  ec.NAME AS client_name,
  co.total_orders,
  NVL(ce.total_executions, 0) AS total_executions
FROM client_orders co
LEFT JOIN client_executions ce ON ce.client_id = co.CLIENT_ID
JOIN ATS.EDS_CLIENTS ec ON ec.CLIENT_ID = co.CLIENT_ID
WHERE NVL(ce.total_executions, 0) < co.total_orders
ORDER BY co.total_orders DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Uses dynamic last full calendar month via ADD_MONTHS/TRUNC; combines buyer+seller executions via UNION ALL; filters clients with >5 orders and executions < orders.

title: Flags most correlated with execution within 1 minute (last 180 days)
question: Which flags (e.g. MIT, LOC) are most correlated with execution within 1 minute?
sql_text:
WITH exec AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.BUYER_ORDER_NO, t.SELLER_ORDER_NO)      AS order_no,
    t.EXCHANGE_ID,
    o.ENTRY_DATETIME                                   AS order_time,
    t.ENTRY_DATETIME                                   AS trade_time,
    f.FLAG_CODE
  FROM ATS.TRADES t
  JOIN ATS.ORDERS o
    ON (t.BUYER_ORDER_NO  = o.ORDER_NO AND t.EXCHANGE_ID = o.EXCHANGE_ID)
    OR (t.SELLER_ORDER_NO = o.ORDER_NO AND t.EXCHANGE_ID = o.EXCHANGE_ID)
  JOIN ATS.FLAGS f
    ON f.FLAG_ID = o.FLAG_ID
  WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 180
    AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 180
),
first_exec AS (
  SELECT
    order_no,
    EXCHANGE_ID,
    order_time,
    MIN(trade_time)          AS first_trade_time,
    FLAG_CODE
  FROM exec
  GROUP BY order_no, EXCHANGE_ID, order_time, FLAG_CODE
)
SELECT
  FLAG_CODE,
  COUNT(*)                                           AS total_executed,
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_trade_time - order_time <= NUMTODSINTERVAL(1,'MINUTE')
           THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                        AS exec_within_1min,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN first_trade_time - order_time <= NUMTODSINTERVAL(1,'MINUTE')
                     THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
  )                                                  AS pct_within_1min
FROM first_exec
GROUP BY FLAG_CODE
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY pct_within_1min DESC, total_executed DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Joins TRADES to ORDERS via buyer/seller order number; uses MIN() to get first execution; computes % executed within 1 minute per FLAG_CODE; filters low-volume flags.

title: 5-day rolling high-low range for top-5 symbols by turnover (last full month)

-- 5-day rolling high-low range for top-5 symbols by turnover (last full month)
WITH month_bounds AS (
  SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1) AS d0,
         TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')               AS d1
  FROM dual
),
top_symbols AS (
  SELECT SYMBOL_ID,
         SUM(TURNOVER_VALUE) AS total_turnover
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS
  WHERE STATS_DATE >= (SELECT d0 FROM month_bounds)
    AND STATS_DATE <  (SELECT d1 FROM month_bounds)
  GROUP BY SYMBOL_ID
  ORDER BY total_turnover DESC
  FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
),
daily_range AS (
  SELECT sdi.SYMBOL_ID,
         sdi.STATS_DATE,
         (sdi.HIGH_PRICE - sdi.LOW_PRICE) AS high_low_range
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  JOIN top_symbols ts ON ts.SYMBOL_ID = sdi.SYMBOL_ID
  WHERE sdi.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 35   -- enough history for a 5-day window
)
SELECT s.SYMBOL,
       dr.STATS_DATE,
       dr.high_low_range,
       AVG(dr.high_low_range) OVER (
         PARTITION BY dr.SYMBOL_ID
         ORDER BY dr.STATS_DATE
         ROWS BETWEEN 4 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS rolling_5d_avg
FROM daily_range dr
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = dr.SYMBOL_ID
ORDER BY s.SYMBOL, dr.STATS_DATE
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Top-5 by SUM(TURNOVER_VALUE) (proxy for volume) in the last full calendar month; 5-row rolling window on (HIGH-LOW); extra 30-day history guarantees the window has data.

title: MoM % change in trades count for bonds (last 12 months)
question: Compare MoM percentage change in trades count for bonds only, last 12 months.
sql_text:
-- MoM % change in trades count for bonds (last 12 months)
WITH bond_monthly AS (
  SELECT TRUNC(sdi.STATS_DATE, 'MM') AS month_start,
         SUM(sdi.TRADES_COUNT)       AS total_trades
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS       s  ON s.SYMBOL_ID = sdi.SYMBOL_ID
  JOIN ATS.SYMBOL_TYPES  st ON st.SYMBOL_TYPE_ID = s.SYMBOL_TYPE_ID
  WHERE sdi.STATS_DATE >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -12)
    AND UPPER(st.SYMBOL_TYPE) LIKE 'BOND%'
  GROUP BY TRUNC(sdi.STATS_DATE, 'MM')
)
SELECT month_start,
       total_trades,
       ROUND(
         (total_trades - LAG(total_trades) OVER (ORDER BY month_start))
         / NULLIF(LAG(total_trades) OVER (ORDER BY month_start), 0) * 100,
         2
       ) AS mom_pct_change
FROM bond_monthly
ORDER BY month_start
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Monthly SUM(TRADES_COUNT) for symbols whose SYMBOL_TYPE contains 'BOND'; MoM % with LAG and safe division.

title: Avg time from entry to PartialFill state by symbol (last quarter)
question: For orders in 'PartialFill' state last quarter, show average time from entry to state change by symbol.

-- Average time from entry to 'PartialFill' state by symbol (last quarter)
WITH q_bounds AS (
  SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q'), -3) AS q_start,
         TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q')               AS q_end
  FROM dual
)
SELECT s.SYMBOL,
       AVG(
         EXTRACT(DAY    FROM (o.STATE_TIME - o.ENTRY_DATETIME)) * 1440 +
         EXTRACT(HOUR   FROM (o.STATE_TIME - o.ENTRY_DATETIME)) * 60 +
         EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM (o.STATE_TIME - o.ENTRY_DATETIME)) +
         EXTRACT(SECOND FROM (o.STATE_TIME - o.ENTRY_DATETIME)) / 60
       ) AS avg_minutes_to_partial_fill
FROM ATS.ORDERS o
JOIN ATS.ORDER_STATES os ON os.STATE_ID = o.STATE
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = o.SYMBOL_ID
CROSS JOIN q_bounds qb
WHERE os.STATE_CODE = 'PartialFill'
  AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= qb.q_start
  AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME <  qb.q_end
GROUP BY s.SYMBOL
ORDER BY avg_minutes_to_partial_fill DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Converts TIMESTAMP interval to minutes using EXTRACT (safe for Oracle); filters to last full quarter via ADD_MONTHS/TRUNC; averages per symbol.

side_notional AS (

title: Cancellation ratio for Repriced state – current year
question: Calculate cancellation ratio (cancelled / total) per exchange for trades in 'Repriced' state this year.
sql_text:
-- Cancellation ratio for Repriced state – current year
WITH cy AS (
  SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')               AS year_start,
         ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'),12) AS year_end
  FROM dual
),
live AS (
  SELECT t.EXCHANGE_ID, COUNT(*) AS live_cnt
  FROM ATS.TRADES t
  JOIN ATS.TRADE_STATES ts ON ts.STATE_ID = t.STATE_ID
  CROSS JOIN cy
  WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= cy.year_start AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME < cy.year_end
    AND ts.STATE_CODE = 'Repriced'
  GROUP BY t.EXCHANGE_ID
),
cancel AS (
  SELECT ct.EXCHANGE_ID, COUNT(*) AS cancel_cnt
  FROM ATS.CANCELLED_TRADES ct
  JOIN ATS.TRADE_STATES ts ON ts.STATE_ID = ct.STATE_ID
  CROSS JOIN cy
  WHERE ct.CANCELLATION_DATETIME >= cy.year_start AND ct.CANCELLATION_DATETIME < cy.year_end
    AND ts.STATE_CODE = 'Repriced'
  GROUP BY ct.EXCHANGE_ID
)
SELECT
  e.EXCHANGE_NAME,
  NVL(l.live_cnt,0)   AS live_trades,
  NVL(c.cancel_cnt,0) AS cancelled_trades,
  ROUND(
    NVL(c.cancel_cnt,0) /
    NULLIF(NVL(l.live_cnt,0) + NVL(c.cancel_cnt,0),0),
    4
  ) AS cancellation_ratio
FROM ATS.EXCHANGES e
LEFT JOIN live   l ON l.EXCHANGE_ID = e.EXCHANGE_ID
LEFT JOIN cancel c ON c.EXCHANGE_ID = e.EXCHANGE_ID
WHERE NVL(l.live_cnt,0) + NVL(c.cancel_cnt,0) > 0
ORDER BY cancellation_ratio DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Separate live & cancelled counts; ratio = cancelled/(live+cancelled); full outer via LEFT JOIN on EXCHANGES.

title: Rejected notional by broker for expiry invalid (2025)

title: % invalid symbol/market rejections by client & exchange (last quarter, >20 rej)
question: For clients with >20 rejections last quarter, show % due to invalid symbol or market, broken down by exchange.
sql_text:
-- % invalid symbol/market rejections by client & exchange (last quarter, clients >20 rejections)
WITH q_bounds AS (
  SELECT ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q'), -3) AS q_start,
         TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'Q')               AS q_end
  FROM dual
),
client_filter AS (
  SELECT ro.CLIENT_ID
  FROM ATS.REJECTED_ORDERS ro
  CROSS JOIN q_bounds q
  WHERE ro.ENTRY_DATETIME >= q.q_start
    AND ro.ENTRY_DATETIME < q.q_end
  GROUP BY ro.CLIENT_ID
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 20
),
rej_detail AS (
  SELECT
    ro.CLIENT_ID,
    ro.EXCHANGE_ID,
    CASE
      WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(UPPER(r.DESCRIPTION), 'INVALID.*SYMBOL|SYMBOL.*INVALID|INVALID.*MARKET|MARKET.*INVALID')
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS is_invalid_sym_mkt
  FROM ATS.REJECTED_ORDERS ro
  JOIN ATS.REJECTIONS r ON r.REJECTION_ID = ro.REJECTION_ID
  CROSS JOIN q_bounds q
  WHERE ro.ENTRY_DATETIME >= q.q_start
    AND ro.ENTRY_DATETIME < q.q_end
    AND ro.CLIENT_ID IN (SELECT CLIENT_ID FROM client_filter)
)
SELECT
  c.NAME AS client_name,
  e.EXCHANGE_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS total_rejections,
  SUM(rd.is_invalid_sym_mkt) AS invalid_sym_mkt_count,
  ROUND(SUM(rd.is_invalid_sym_mkt) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_invalid_sym_mkt
FROM rej_detail rd
JOIN ATS.EDS_CLIENTS c ON c.CLIENT_ID = rd.CLIENT_ID
JOIN ATS.EXCHANGES e ON e.EXCHANGE_ID = rd.EXCHANGE_ID
GROUP BY c.NAME, e.EXCHANGE_NAME
ORDER BY pct_invalid_sym_mkt DESC, total_rejections DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Filters clients with >20 rejections in last full quarter; REGEXP_LIKE for robust 'invalid symbol/market' match; per-client per-exchange %.

title: Daily avg repo haircut by maturity bucket (BuyBack, last year)
question: Show daily average repo haircut for 'BuyBack' contracts by maturity bucket over the last year.
sql_text:
-- Daily average repo haircut for BuyBack by maturity bucket (last year)
WITH last_year AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(rc.ENTRY_DATETIME) AS entry_day,
    TRUNC(rc.TERMINATION_DATE) - TRUNC(rc.INITIAL_DATE) AS maturity_days,
    rc.REPO_HAIRCUT
  FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS rc
  WHERE rc.REPO_TYPE = 'BuyBack'
    AND rc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE), -12)
    AND rc.ENTRY_DATETIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE)
    AND rc.INITIAL_DATE IS NOT NULL
    AND rc.TERMINATION_DATE IS NOT NULL
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    entry_day,
    maturity_days,
    REPO_HAIRCUT,
    CASE
      WHEN maturity_days BETWEEN 0  AND 7   THEN '0–7d'
      WHEN maturity_days BETWEEN 8  AND 30  THEN '8–30d'
      WHEN maturity_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90  THEN '31–90d'
      ELSE '>90d'
    END AS maturity_bucket
  FROM last_year
)
SELECT
  entry_day,
  maturity_bucket,
  ROUND(AVG(REPO_HAIRCUT), 4) AS avg_haircut,
  COUNT(*) AS contract_count
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY entry_day, maturity_bucket
ORDER BY entry_day DESC, maturity_bucket
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Dynamic maturity bucket; excludes invalid dates; daily grain.

title: Repo log events by state (cancelled vs executed, this year)
question: Count repo log events by state for contracts that were cancelled vs executed this year.

-- Repo log events by state for cancelled vs executed contracts (this year)
WITH cy AS (
  SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS y_start,
         ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 12) AS y_end
  FROM dual
),
contract_status AS (
  SELECT rc.CONTRACT_NO, 'Executed' AS status
  FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS rc
  CROSS JOIN cy
  WHERE rc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= cy.y_start AND rc.ENTRY_DATETIME < cy.y_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT rcc.CONTRACT_NO, 'Cancelled'
  FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS_CANCELLED rcc
  CROSS JOIN cy
  WHERE rcc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= cy.y_start AND rcc.ENTRY_DATETIME < cy.y_end
),
final_status AS (
  SELECT
    CONTRACT_NO,
    MAX(status) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) AS final_status
  FROM contract_status
  GROUP BY CONTRACT_NO
)
SELECT
  fs.final_status,
  ts.STATE_CODE,
  COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM ATS.REPO_LOG rl
JOIN final_status fs ON fs.CONTRACT_NO = rl.CONTRACT_ID
LEFT JOIN ATS.TRADE_STATES ts ON ts.STATE_ID = rl.PRIVATE_ORDER_STATE
CROSS JOIN cy
WHERE rl.ENTRY_DATETIME >= cy.y_start AND rl.ENTRY_DATETIME < cy.y_end
GROUP BY fs.final_status, ts.STATE_CODE
ORDER BY fs.final_status, event_count DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Prioritizes 'Cancelled' status; joins log events to final contract status; current year bounds.

title: Top 5 most sold symbols by the biggest broker by sell notional (current year)
question: Show the top 5 symbols with the highest sell notional from the broker with the highest total sell notional in the current year.
sql_text:
-- Top 5 most sold symbols by the biggest broker by sell notional (current year)
WITH broker_ranking AS (
  SELECT BROKER_ID
  FROM (
    SELECT SELLER_BROKER_ID AS BROKER_ID, SUM(PRICE * VOLUME) AS notional
    FROM ATS.TRADES
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ENTRY_DATETIME) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)
    GROUP BY SELLER_BROKER_ID
    ORDER BY notional DESC
  ) FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
),
symbol_ranking AS (
  SELECT s.SYMBOL, SUM(t.PRICE * t.VOLUME) AS notional_value
  FROM ATS.TRADES t
  JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON t.SYMBOL_ID = s.SYMBOL_ID
  JOIN broker_ranking br ON t.SELLER_BROKER_ID = br.BROKER_ID
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM t.ENTRY_DATETIME) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)
  GROUP BY s.SYMBOL
  ORDER BY notional_value DESC
  FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
)
SELECT SYMBOL, notional_value FROM symbol_ranking;
notes: Uses TRADES (not ORDERS) for executed volume; identifies top broker by total sell notional using SELLER_BROKER_ID; computes notional as PRICE * VOLUME; filters current calendar year via EXTRACT(YEAR...); never uses SIDE on TRADES table.

title: Symbols bought more in 2021 than 2022
question: Find symbols with higher buy volume in 2021 than in 2022.

-- Symbols bought more in 2021 than 2022
WITH orders_2021 AS (

  FROM ATS.ORDERS o
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ENTRY_DATETIME) = 2021 AND o.SIDE = 'B'
  GROUP BY o.SYMBOL_ID
),
orders_2022 AS (

  FROM ATS.ORDERS o
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.ENTRY_DATETIME) = 2022 AND o.SIDE = 'B'
  GROUP BY o.SYMBOL_ID
)
SELECT

FROM orders_2021 o2021

LEFT JOIN orders_2022 o2022 ON o2022.SYMBOL_ID = o2021.SYMBOL_ID
WHERE o2021.buy_volume_2021 > NVL(o2022.buy_volume_2022, 0)
ORDER BY (o2021.buy_volume_2021 - NVL(o2022.buy_volume_2022, 0)) DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Use ORDERS + SIDE='B' for buy intent. Use LEFT JOIN + NVL to handle missing years. Never use TRADES for side-specific volume. Never INNER JOIN max(year1) with min(year2).

title: Symbol with highest buy volume increase: current vs previous decade
question: Which symbol was bought more in this decade than in the previous decade?
sql_text:
-- Symbol with largest buy volume increase: current decade vs previous
WITH decade_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(TO_DATE(FLOOR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)/10)*10 || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS curr_start,
    TRUNC(TO_DATE(FLOOR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)/10)*10 - 10 || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AS prev_start,
    TRUNC(TO_DATE(FLOOR(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM SYSDATE)/10)*10 || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) - INTERVAL '1' SECOND AS prev_end
  FROM dual
),
curr AS (
  SELECT o.SYMBOL_ID, SUM(o.VOLUME) AS vol
  FROM ATS.ORDERS o, decade_bounds d
  WHERE o.SIDE = 'B' AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= d.curr_start AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME <= SYSDATE
  GROUP BY o.SYMBOL_ID
),
prev AS (
  SELECT o.SYMBOL_ID, SUM(o.VOLUME) AS vol
  FROM ATS.ORDERS o, decade_bounds d
  WHERE o.SIDE = 'B' AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= d.prev_start AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME <= d.prev_end
  GROUP BY o.SYMBOL_ID
)
SELECT s.SYMBOL, NVL(c.vol,0) AS this_decade, NVL(p.vol,0) AS prev_decade, (NVL(c.vol,0)-NVL(p.vol,0)) AS increase
FROM curr c
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = c.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN prev p ON p.SYMBOL_ID = c.SYMBOL_ID
WHERE NVL(c.vol,0) > NVL(p.vol,0)
ORDER BY increase DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY;
notes: Use ORDERS + SIDE='B' for buy volume. Define decades as 2010-2019 vs 2020-2029. Use LEFT JOIN + NVL. Rank by (current - prev) DESC. NEVER use MAX(current) AND MIN(prev) — impossible. Never use TRADES or DAILY_INDICATORS for side-specific volume.

title: Repo yearly volume by leg (2015–2025) + top client per year
question: What is the yearly repo volume broken down by exchange and leg from 2015 to 2025, and who was the top client by total repo volume each year?
sql_text:
-- Repo yearly volume by leg (2015–2025) + top client per year
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    rc.ENTRY_DATETIME,
    rc.EXCHANGE_ID,
    rc.LEG,
    rc.VOLUME,
    rc.BUYER_CLIENT_ID,
    rc.SELLER_CLIENT_ID
  FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS rc
  WHERE rc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= DATE '2015-01-01'
    AND rc.ENTRY_DATETIME < DATE '2026-01-01'
),

-- 1) Yearly volume by exchange & leg
yearly_leg_volume AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(b.ENTRY_DATETIME, 'YYYY') AS year,
    e.EXCHANGE_NAME                  AS exchange,
    b.LEG,
    SUM(b.VOLUME)                    AS leg_volume
  FROM base b
  JOIN ATS.EXCHANGES e
    ON e.EXCHANGE_ID = b.EXCHANGE_ID
  GROUP BY
    TRUNC(b.ENTRY_DATETIME, 'YYYY'),
    e.EXCHANGE_NAME,
    b.LEG
),

-- 2) Yearly volume per client (buyer + seller)
client_yearly_volume AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(p.ENTRY_DATETIME, 'YYYY') AS year,
    p.client_id,
    SUM(p.vol)                      AS client_volume
  FROM (
    SELECT
      b.ENTRY_DATETIME,
      b.BUYER_CLIENT_ID AS client_id,
      b.VOLUME          AS vol
    FROM base b
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      b.ENTRY_DATETIME,
      b.SELLER_CLIENT_ID AS client_id,
      b.VOLUME           AS vol
    FROM base b
  ) p
  GROUP BY
    TRUNC(p.ENTRY_DATETIME, 'YYYY'),
    p.client_id
),

-- 3) Top client per year by total repo volume
top_client_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    client_id,
    client_volume,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY year
      ORDER BY client_volume DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM client_yearly_volume
)

-- 4) Combine: per-year leg volumes + that year's top client
SELECT
  yv.year,
  yv.exchange,
  yv.LEG,
  yv.leg_volume,
  tc.client_id         AS top_client_id,
  c.NAME               AS top_client_name,
  tc.client_volume     AS top_client_volume
FROM yearly_leg_volume yv
JOIN top_client_per_year tc
  ON tc.year = yv.year
 AND tc.rn   = 1
LEFT JOIN ATS.EDS_CLIENTS c
  ON c.CLIENT_ID = tc.client_id
ORDER BY
  yv.year,
  yv.exchange,
  yv.LEG,
  yv.leg_volume DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
notes: Covers full years 2015–2025; aggregates repo volume by exchange and leg; separately calculates total yearly volume per client (counting both sides); identifies top client each year; joins client name via EDS_CLIENTS.

title: Client with highest Buy/Sell notional ratio (TRADES, current year)
question: Which client had the highest Buy to Sell notional ratio based on executed trades in the current year?
sql_text:
-- Client with the highest Buy to Sell notional ratio (executed TRADES, current year)
WITH trade_roles AS (
    -- Buyer leg
    SELECT
        t.BUYER_CLIENT_ID AS client_id,
        t.PRICE * t.VOLUME AS buy_notional,
        0                   AS sell_notional
    FROM ATS.TRADES t
    WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
      AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME <  ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 1)

    UNION ALL

    -- Seller leg
    SELECT
        t.SELLER_CLIENT_ID AS client_id,
        0                   AS buy_notional,
        t.PRICE * t.VOLUME AS sell_notional
    FROM ATS.TRADES t
    WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')
      AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME <  ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY'), 1)
)
SELECT
    c.NAME AS client_name,
    SUM(tr.buy_notional) AS buy_notional,
    SUM(tr.sell_notional) AS sell_notional,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(tr.sell_notional) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(SUM(tr.buy_notional) / SUM(tr.sell_notional), 4)
    END AS buy_to_sell_ratio
FROM trade_roles tr
JOIN ATS.EDS_CLIENTS c
    ON c.CLIENT_ID = tr.client_id
GROUP BY c.NAME
HAVING SUM(tr.sell_notional) > 0
ORDER BY buy_to_sell_ratio DESC
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Computes executed buy and sell notional per client from ATS.TRADES using a UNION ALL role-normalisation pattern and avoids OR joins. Filters ENTRY_DATETIME to the current calendar year and returns the top 10 clients by buy/sell notional ratio.

title: Symbol with largest year-start vs year-end price difference (SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS, 2022)
question: Which symbol has the biggest difference between its year-start open and year-end close in 2022?
sql_text:
-- Symbol with the biggest difference between its year-end close and year-start open in 2022
WITH daily_data_2022 AS (
  SELECT
    sdi.SYMBOL_ID,
    sdi.STATS_DATE,
    sdi.OPEN_PRICE,
    sdi.CLOSE_PRICE,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sdi.SYMBOL_ID ORDER BY sdi.STATS_DATE ASC)  AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sdi.SYMBOL_ID ORDER BY sdi.STATS_DATE DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  WHERE sdi.STATS_DATE >= DATE '2022-01-01'
    AND sdi.STATS_DATE <  DATE '2023-01-01'
),
year_prices AS (
  SELECT
    d.SYMBOL_ID,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.rn_asc  = 1 THEN d.OPEN_PRICE  END) AS first_day_open,
    MAX(CASE WHEN d.rn_desc = 1 THEN d.CLOSE_PRICE END) AS last_day_close
  FROM daily_data_2022 d
  GROUP BY d.SYMBOL_ID
)
SELECT
  sym.SYMBOL,
  yp.first_day_open,
  yp.last_day_close,
  ABS(yp.last_day_close - yp.first_day_open) AS ohlc_difference
FROM year_prices yp
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS sym ON sym.SYMBOL_ID = yp.SYMBOL_ID
WHERE yp.first_day_open IS NOT NULL AND yp.last_day_close IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(yp.last_day_close - yp.first_day_open) DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Computes, for each symbol, the OPEN_PRICE on the first trading day of 2022 and the CLOSE_PRICE on the last trading day of 2022, then ranks by the absolute difference. Uses ROW_NUMBER windows over STATS_DATE within ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS and joins to ATS.SYMBOLS for the symbol label.

title: Top 10 symbols by highest average relative quoted spread (last 200 trading days)
question: Over the last 200 trading days, identify the 10 symbols with the highest average quoted spread relative to their average mid-price. Show symbol, average spread, average mid, and spread as a percentage of mid
sql_text:
-- Top 10 symbols with highest average relative quoted spread (last 200 trading days)
-- Correctly averages (spread/mid) per quote, not (avg spread)/(avg mid)
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT
    s.SYMBOL,
    b.BID_PRICE,
    b.OFFER_PRICE,
    (b.OFFER_PRICE - b.BID_PRICE) AS spread,
    (b.BID_PRICE + b.OFFER_PRICE) / 2 AS mid_price
  FROM ATS.BEST_MKT b
  JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = b.SYMBOL_ID
  WHERE b.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 200   -- last ~200 calendar days ≈ 200 trading days
    AND b.ENTRY_DATETIME <  TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
    AND b.BID_PRICE  > 0
    AND b.OFFER_PRICE > b.BID_PRICE   -- basic sanity filter
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    SYMBOL,
    AVG(spread)                                   AS avg_spread,
    AVG(mid_price)                                AS avg_mid,
    AVG(100 * spread / NULLIF(mid_price, 0))      AS avg_relative_spread_pct,
    COUNT(*)                                      AS quote_count
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY SYMBOL
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100   -- optional: require minimum liquidity / data points
)
SELECT
  SYMBOL,
  ROUND(avg_spread, 4)          AS avg_spread,
  ROUND(avg_mid, 4)             AS avg_mid,
  ROUND(avg_relative_spread_pct, 4) AS spread_pct_of_mid,
  quote_count
FROM agg
ORDER BY avg_relative_spread_pct DESC NULLS LAST
FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
notes: Uses correct relative spread: average of (spread/mid) per quote, not (avg spread)/(avg mid). Protects against division-by-zero with NULLIF and filters out zero/negative mids. Added basic sanity filters and optional minimum quote count for reliability.

title: Brokers with most circular / round-trip trading activity (same symbol, last completed 30 days)
question: Which brokers are involved in the most circular trading patterns (A sells to B and B sells back to A the same symbol) in the last ~30 days?
sql_text:
-- Detect brokers with circular (A→B and B→A) trades on the same symbol
-- Covers the completed portion of the current month (~last 30 days)
WITH circular_trades AS (
  SELECT
    t.BUYER_BROKER_ID,
    t.SELLER_BROKER_ID,
    t.SYMBOL_ID,
    t.ENTRY_DATETIME
  FROM ATS.TRADES t
  WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') - INTERVAL '30' DAY  -- start of last 30 days
    AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')                    -- up to start of current month
    AND t.BUYER_BROKER_ID != t.SELLER_BROKER_ID
),
broker_pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    ct.BUYER_BROKER_ID,
    ct.SELLER_BROKER_ID,
    ct.SYMBOL_ID
  FROM circular_trades ct
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM circular_trades ct2
    WHERE ct2.BUYER_BROKER_ID = ct.SELLER_BROKER_ID
      AND ct2.SELLER_BROKER_ID = ct.BUYER_BROKER_ID
      AND ct2.SYMBOL_ID = ct.SYMBOL_ID
  )
)
SELECT
  sb.BROKER_NAME,
  COUNT(*) AS circular_trading_count
FROM broker_pairs bp
JOIN ATS.SUBSCRIBED_BROKERS sb ON sb.BROKER_ID = bp.BUYER_BROKER_ID
GROUP BY sb.BROKER_NAME
ORDER BY circular_trading_count DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
notes: Detects round-trip patterns (A→B and B→A on same symbol). Each unique (broker, counterparty, symbol) pair with both directions counts once. Classic wash-trade / circular trading surveillance query.

title: Daily cancelled orders count last completed month — market-wise
question: Number of cancelled orders in last month, each day, market-wise
sql_text:
-- Daily cancelled orders (STATE_CODE = 'Cancel') in the last completed calendar month, broken down by market
SELECT
  TRUNC(o.ENTRY_DATETIME, 'DD')              AS order_day,
  m.MARKET_CODE                              AS market_code,
  COUNT(*)                                   AS cancelled_orders_count
FROM ATS.ORDERS o
JOIN ATS.ORDER_STATES os ON os.STATE_ID = o.STATE
JOIN ATS.MARKETS m       ON m.MARKET_ID = o.MARKET_ID
WHERE os.STATE_CODE = 'Cancel'
  AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), -1)   -- first day of previous month
  AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME <  TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM')                  -- first day of current month
GROUP BY TRUNC(o.ENTRY_DATETIME, 'DD'), m.MARKET_CODE
ORDER BY order_day DESC, cancelled_orders_count DESC
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY
notes: Uses ORDERS.STATE → ORDER_STATES.STATE_CODE = 'Cancel' as the canonical way to identify cancelled orders. Market breakdown via MARKETS.MARKET_CODE (not EXCHANGES).

title: Daily purged orders count last completed month — market-wise

title: Latest OHLC for Top 45 symbols by traded value (last 30 days)
question: Give me the OHLC of the Top 45 symbols by volume
sql_text:
-- Latest OHLC for Top 45 symbols ranked by total traded value (TURNOVER_VALUE) over last 30 calendar days
-- One clean row per symbol with current Open, High, Low, Close
WITH volume_ranking AS (
  SELECT
    sdi.SYMBOL_ID,
    SUM(sdi.TURNOVER_VALUE) AS total_traded_value
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  WHERE sdi.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
    AND sdi.STATS_DATE <  TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1
  GROUP BY sdi.SYMBOL_ID
  ORDER BY total_traded_value DESC
  FETCH FIRST 45 ROWS ONLY
),
latest_day AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    sdi.SYMBOL_ID,
    FIRST_VALUE(sdi.STATS_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY sdi.SYMBOL_ID ORDER BY sdi.STATS_DATE DESC) AS latest_date
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  WHERE sdi.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
    AND sdi.SYMBOL_ID IN (SELECT SYMBOL_ID FROM volume_ranking)
),
latest_ohlc AS (
  SELECT
    sdi.SYMBOL_ID,
    sdi.STATS_DATE,
    sdi.OPEN_PRICE   AS open_price,
    sdi.HIGH_PRICE   AS high_price,
    sdi.LOW_PRICE    AS low_price,
    sdi.CLOSE_PRICE  AS close_price,
    sdi.TURNOVER_VALUE
  FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi
  JOIN latest_day ld
    ON sdi.SYMBOL_ID = ld.SYMBOL_ID
   AND sdi.STATS_DATE = ld.latest_date
)
SELECT
  sym.SYMBOL,
  lo.open_price,
  lo.high_price,
  lo.low_price,
  lo.close_price,
  ROUND(vr.total_traded_value / 1e6, 2) AS total_traded_value_millions,
  lo.TURNOVER_VALUE AS latest_day_volume
FROM volume_ranking vr
JOIN latest_ohlc lo ON lo.SYMBOL_ID = vr.SYMBOL_ID
JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS sym ON sym.SYMBOL_ID = vr.SYMBOL_ID
ORDER BY vr.total_traded_value DESC
notes: Ranks symbols by total TURNOVER_VALUE over last 30 days (standard volume proxy). Then pulls the SINGLE most recent day's OHLC (not average, not max/min). This is the industry-standard and only correct way to answer 'OHLC of top N symbols by volume'.

title: Complete order lifecycle for all orders in January 2024 (placement, states, details)
question: For any order in January 2024, show the complete order lifecycle: placement time, state changes, and all related information

title: Complete repo transaction cycle (leg 1 to leg 2) with all details for January 2025

title: Orders executed on the same day they were placed (last 30 days)
question: Show me a list of orders which were executed on the same day on which they were placed (last 30 days).

 AND t.EXCHANGE_ID = o.EXCHANGE_ID

title: Short vs Normal trades by symbol – current year (2025) – counts and volumes
question: For every symbol this year, compare total short trades versus normal trades, showing trade count and volume for short and non-short side by side.
sql_text:
-- Compare short vs normal trades by symbol for the current year (2025)
SELECT s.SYMBOL AS symbol, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.IS_SHORT = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS short_trade_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.IS_SHORT = '1' THEN t.VOLUME ELSE 0 END), 0) AS short_trade_volume, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.IS_SHORT = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal_trade_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.IS_SHORT = '0' THEN t.VOLUME ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal_trade_volume, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.IS_SHORT = '1' THEN t.VOLUME ELSE 0 END), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.IS_SHORT = '0' THEN t.VOLUME ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_volume FROM ATS.TRADES t JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON s.SYMBOL_ID = t.SYMBOL_ID WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.SYMBOL ORDER BY total_volume DESC, s.SYMBOL FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Uses IS_SHORT = '1' for genuine short-selling trades (borrow required) and '0' for normal long trades. COALESCE ensures symbols with only one type appear with zeros. Fixed calendar-year filter (2025). Never confuse with SIDE column – 'S' just means sell-side, not short.

title: Complete annual activity report for a broker (2025 example)
question: Give me a complete trading report for the broker BFA CAPITAL MARKETS, SDVM, SA. for the year 2025
sql_text:
-- Complete broker activity report – 2025 (canonical pattern)
WITH broker_lookup (broker_id) AS (
  SELECT BROKER_ID FROM ATS.SUBSCRIBED_BROKERS WHERE BROKER_NAME = 'BFA CAPITAL MARKETS, SDVM, SA.'

title: Complete annual report for a single symbol (all domains – 2024 example)
question: Give me a complete report for the symbol BCGAAAAA for the year 2024
sql_text:
-- Complete symbol report – canonical pattern (2024 example)
WITH year_bounds AS (SELECT DATE '2024-01-01' AS y_start, DATE '2025-01-01' AS y_end FROM dual),
target_symbol AS (SELECT SYMBOL_ID, SYMBOL FROM ATS.SYMBOLS WHERE SYMBOL = 'BCGAAAAA'),
daily AS (SELECT SUM(si.TURNOVER_VALUE) AS turnover, SUM(si.TRADES_COUNT) AS trades_cnt, AVG(si.CLOSE_PRICE) AS close_price, MAX(si.HIGH_PRICE) AS high, MIN(si.LOW_PRICE) AS low FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS si JOIN target_symbol ts ON si.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID CROSS JOIN year_bounds yb WHERE si.STATS_DATE >= yb.y_start AND si.STATS_DATE < yb.y_end GROUP BY si.SYMBOL_ID),
intraday AS (SELECT SUM(s.VOLUME) AS volume, SUM(s.VALUE) AS turnover FROM ATS.SYMBOL_INDICATORS s JOIN target_symbol ts ON s.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID CROSS JOIN year_bounds yb WHERE s.ENTRY_DATETIME >= yb.y_start AND s.ENTRY_DATETIME < yb.y_end GROUP BY s.SYMBOL_ID),
orders AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(o.VOLUME) AS vol, SUM(o.VOLUME*o.PRICE) AS notional, SUM(CASE WHEN o.SIDE='B' THEN o.VOLUME ELSE 0 END) AS buy_vol, SUM(CASE WHEN o.SIDE='S' THEN o.VOLUME ELSE 0 END) AS sell_vol, AVG(o.PRICE) AS avg_price FROM ATS.ORDERS o JOIN target_symbol ts ON o.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID CROSS JOIN year_bounds yb WHERE o.ENTRY_DATETIME >= yb.y_start AND o.ENTRY_DATETIME < yb.y_end GROUP BY o.SYMBOL_ID),
trades AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(t.VOLUME) AS vol, SUM(t.PRICE*t.VOLUME) AS notional, AVG(t.PRICE) AS avg_price FROM ATS.TRADES t JOIN target_symbol ts ON t.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID CROSS JOIN year_bounds yb WHERE t.ENTRY_DATETIME >= yb.y_start AND t.ENTRY_DATETIME < yb.y_end GROUP BY t.SYMBOL_ID),
rejected AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ATS.REJECTED_ORDERS ro JOIN target_symbol ts ON ro.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID CROSS JOIN year_bounds yb WHERE ro.ENTRY_DATETIME >= yb.y_start AND ro.ENTRY_DATETIME < yb.y_end GROUP BY ro.SYMBOL_ID),
repo AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS legs, SUM(rc.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT) AS cash_flow, AVG(rc.REPO_RATE) AS rate, AVG(rc.REPO_HAIRCUT) AS haircut FROM ATS.REPO_CONTRACTS rc JOIN target_symbol ts ON rc.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID CROSS JOIN year_bounds yb WHERE rc.ENTRY_DATETIME >= yb.y_start AND rc.ENTRY_DATETIME < yb.y_end GROUP BY rc.SYMBOL_ID)
SELECT ts.SYMBOL,
  NVL(d.turnover,0) AS daily_turnover, NVL(d.trades_cnt,0) AS daily_trades_count, NVL(d.close_price,0) AS avg_daily_close,
  NVL(i.volume,0) AS intraday_volume, NVL(i.turnover,0) AS intraday_turnover,
  NVL(o.cnt,0) AS orders_count, NVL(o.vol,0) AS order_volume, NVL(o.notional,0) AS order_notional, NVL(o.buy_vol,0) AS buy_volume, NVL(o.sell_vol,0) AS sell_volume,
  NVL(t.cnt,0) AS trades_count, NVL(t.vol,0) AS trade_volume, NVL(t.notional,0) AS trade_notional,
  NVL(r.cnt,0) AS rejected_orders_count,
  NVL(p.legs,0) AS repo_legs, NVL(p.cash_flow,0) AS repo_cash_flow, NVL(p.rate,0) AS avg_repo_rate
FROM target_symbol ts
LEFT JOIN daily d ON d.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN intraday i ON i.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN trades t ON t.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN rejected r ON r.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID
LEFT JOIN repo p ON p.SYMBOL_ID = ts.SYMBOL_ID
FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Canonical symbol report pattern. Uses year_bounds CTE for clean date handling. Only first CTE has column list (safe WITH syntax). All domains aggregated and LEFT JOINed for single-row beautiful output. Never returns SYMBOL_ID in final SELECT.

title: Symbols with >10% price growth YTD (2025) – ranked by percentage
question: Symbols that increased >10% in price this year, ranked by growth
sql_text:
-- Symbols with >10% price growth YTD (2025) – ranked by percentage
WITH yearly_performance AS (SELECT s.SYMBOL, ((MAX(sdi.CLOSE_PRICE) - MIN(sdi.OPEN_PRICE)) / NULLIF(MIN(sdi.OPEN_PRICE), 0)) * 100 AS percentage_change FROM ATS.SYMBOL_DAILY_INDICATORS sdi JOIN ATS.SYMBOLS s ON sdi.SYMBOL_ID = s.SYMBOL_ID WHERE sdi.STATS_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND sdi.STATS_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') + INTERVAL '1' YEAR AND sdi.OPEN_PRICE <> 0 AND sdi.OPEN_PRICE IS NOT NULL AND sdi.CLOSE_PRICE <> 0 AND sdi.CLOSE_PRICE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.SYMBOL HAVING MIN(sdi.OPEN_PRICE) <> 0 AND MIN(sdi.OPEN_PRICE) IS NOT NULL) SELECT SYMBOL, percentage_change FROM yearly_performance WHERE percentage_change > 10 ORDER BY percentage_change DESC FETCH FIRST 200 ROWS ONLY;
notes: Price growth = (max close - min open)/min open *100. Filters per-row non-zero/null prices in WHERE; aggregate checks in HAVING. For negative growth, change WHERE >10 to < -10 and ORDER ASC.
